title.value: Do not Waste Money on Advertising Spend: Bid Recommendation via Concavity Changes
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the focus of the paper is on optimizing ad spend through bid recommendations.
title.quote: Do not Waste Money on Advertising Spend: Bid Recommendation via Concavity Changes.

extractions.description: The paper discusses a bid recommendation scenario for advertisers to achieve optimal returns on investment by identifying inflection points in click prediction curves. It applies parametric learning methods to solve optimization problems and demonstrates performance gains in business metrics.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on optimizing advertising spending and improving business metrics, which is not directly related to Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: This paper presents a bid recommendation scenario that discovers the concavity changes in click prediction curves.

primary_category.justification: The paper is focused on computational advertising and optimizing bids for advertisers, with no direct connection to Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: In computational advertising business, the publishers sell the ad inventories to the advertisers who win the auctions in ad exchange based on generalized second-price (GSP).
